headline: Pakistan Sensitive Price Index inflation dips 0.11% weekly
summary: Pakistan's Sensitive Price Index (SPI)-based inflation decreased by 0.11% for the week ending November 26, driven by lower prices for tomatoes, onions, and LPG.
why: The SPI is a high-frequency indicator of inflation in Pakistan, providing early signals for central bank monetary policy decisions.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower inflation readings may reduce pressure on the central bank to raise interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
